title: Boswellia serrata essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Boswellia serrata essential oil is derived from the resin of the frankincense tree, known for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. It is widely used in herbalism to support joint health and alleviate symptoms of conditions like arthritis. The oil is often applied topically to reduce pain and inflammation in muscles and joints. It may also be used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and ease respiratory congestion. Due to its potent nature, it is typically diluted before use to avoid skin irritation.
